description.value: RMU is an employee-owned mountain bike and ski brand with a flagship restaurant and bar located at the Le Chamois Hotel in Whistler's Upper Village. The shop sells its own line of bikes — including the NIGHTTRAIN 170mm enduro freeride model — alongside skis, mountain bike packs, and apparel, all under the same roof as a full food and beverage offering spanning coffee and breakfast through pizza and burgers. For a cycling tourist, it is a practical dual-purpose stop: refuel with a meal or coffee while browsing or servicing gear in the heart of Whistler's mountain bike scene.
